title: 1권 5유닛 장면 · 1
prompt: Children's picture-book illustration, hand-drawn 2D style, thick soft dark-brown outlines, flat bright cheerful colors with a light paper texture and gentle watercolor shading, rounded friendly shapes. No photo-realism, no 3D render look. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, logos or watermarks anywhere in the image. Full illustrated scene with a simple uncluttered background and a calm, simple sky area near the top, characters large and clearly visible. No text, no letters. Do NOT draw any speech bubbles, thought bubbles or empty white balloons of any kind. The characters must look exactly like the ones in the attached character sheet (left to right: Pip, Bun, Hedgie, Grumble). Scene: A bright morning on the winding path of the first Sound Garden. Bun, Hedgie and Pip stroll past the first letter trees in a row: an apple tree, a tree with bus-, bag- and bed-shaped fruits, a tree with cat-, cup- and candy-shaped fruits, and a tree with dog-, duck- and doll-shaped fruits. Pip stands under the apple tree about to say a sound, but its beak is scrunched up for a huge sneeze, feathers puffed. Bun counts the trees on her paw; Hedgie carries a small red backpack. Hidden in the picture: a red apple on the ground, a toy bus on the path, an orange cat under a tree, a brown puppy. Grumble does NOT appear. Characters: Pip is a small round yellow baby songbird standing on tiny orange feet, big sparkling black eyes with rosy cheeks, a cowlick of three little feathers on top of the head, a cream-colored belly patch shaped like a musical note, short stubby wings held like little arms, a small orange beak closed shyly, wearing a single small green leaf tied around its neck like a scarf. Bun is a small white rabbit standing on two legs, one long ear flopped down, green rain boots, brave smile. Hedgie is a small hedgehog standing on two legs, soft spikes with one tiny flower stuck in them, curious cautious eyes. Grumble is a grumpy old raccoon standing on two legs, dark eye mask, a striped nightcap, holding a tiny candle lantern in one paw, frowning sleepily, slippers.
